title: Jallikattu
desc: Arjun wants to avenge the murders of his family members, but he is arrested by the police. However, the judge decides to help Arjun.

title: The Fighterman Singham 2
desc: Duraisingam, undercover NCC officer, fights coastal crime with Bhai and Thangaraj as allies to a drug dealer. Sathya admires him; Kavya awaits marriage. One-man army triumphs.

title: The Masterpiece
desc: A tense college rivalry turns deadly when a student is murdered. A professor arrives to bring change, unraveling secrets in this Malayalam action crime drama starring Mammootty.

title: Satyabhama
desc: ACP Satyabhama hunts a missing person, exposing secrets in shadowy towns. Haunted by her past, she pursues truth and redemption in a tense case.

title: Tiger Nageswara Rao
desc: This is about Tiger Nageswara Rao, a famous robber from Stuartpuram, Andhra Pradesh in the 1970s, known for clever tricks to escape police and prison.

title: Mohini
desc: Vaishnavi and Sandeep, an engaged couple, face turmoil as Vaishnavi is possessed by a vengeful lookalike, causing their lives to spiral out of control.

title: Seizer
desc: A rugged repossession agent gets entangled in a high-stakes feud. As danger escalates, he must outsmart deadly foes and fight his way through betrayal and corruption to survive.

title: Meharbaan
desc: A gripping tale of betrayal and redemption unfolds as a family battles deception, ambition, and emotional wounds, seeking strength in unity and forgiveness.

title: Sivudu
desc: A crime ridden neighborhood threatens a youngster, endangering his family and life. Determined to resist, he faces danger and changes his fate by taking a stand.
